pages.title: Forging
pages.text: Load a valid workpiece and hold a hammer. Forge recipes define an ordered sequence of Flatten, Draw, and Bend actions. The broad center flattens, outer working edges draw, and the horn bends. A wrong action does not advance or damage the hammer.

pages.title: Heat
pages.text: Heat the workpiece in a fueled Kiln, then retrieve it and place it on the Stone Anvil. Heat and completed actions stay on the item when it moves. Sneak-use with an empty hand to retrieve unfinished work for reheating. A warm workpiece is too cold to forge; heat it until Workable. The glow and surrounding light fade as it cools.

pages.title: Legacy Recipes
pages.text: Recipes without forge metadata keep the old hammer-smashing behavior and their configured work count. Started forge work locks further input/catalyst insertion until the work is completed or retrieved.
